verses.en: When therefore the Lord knew how the Pharisees had heard that Jesus made and baptized more disciples than John,
verses.sm: UA silafia e le Alii ua faalogo e ^ le au faresaio, e toatele soo ua faia e Iesu ma papatisoina, a e toaitiiti a Ioane;

verses.en: (Though Jesus himself baptized not, but his disciples,)
verses.sm: (peitai o Iesu, e lei papatiso e ia, na o ona soo,)

verses.en: He left Judaea, and departed again into Galilee.
verses.sm: ona tuua lea e ia o Iutaia, a ua toe maliu atu i Kalilaia.

verses.en: And he must needs go through Samaria.
verses.sm: E ao ina ui atu o ia i Samaria.

verses.en: Then cometh he to a city of Samaria, which is called Sychar, near to the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.
verses.sm: Ua oo atu ia i le tasi aai o Samaria, o Sukara le igoa, e latalata ane i le fanua na avatu e Iakopo i lona atalii o Iosefa.

verses.en: Now Jacob's well was there. Jesus therefore, being wearied with his journey, sat thus on the well: and it was about the sixth hour.
verses.sm: Ua i ai le vaipuna o Iakopo. Ua le lavā foi Iesu i lana malaga, ona nofo ai lea o ia i luga o le vai, ua oo i le itu aso po ua ono.

verses.en: There cometh a woman of Samaria to draw water: Jesus saith unto her, Give me to drink.
verses.sm: Ua sau le fafine o Samaria e utu vai. Ua fetalai atu Iesu ia te ia, Au mai ia ia te au,

verses.en: (For his disciples were gone away unto the city to buy meat.)
verses.sm: ou te inu. (Auā ua o atu ona soo i le aai e faatau ai ni mea e ‘ai.)

verses.en: Then saith the woman of Samaria unto him, How is it that thou, being a Jew, askest drink of me, which am a woman of Samaria? for the Jews have no dealings with the Samaritans.
verses.sm: Ona fai mai lea o le fafine o Samaria ia te ia, Pe faapefea ona e fai mai i se mea e inu ia te a‘u, o le fafine o Samaria, a o oe o le Iutaia? auā e leai ni mea e feaveai a Iutaia ma Samaria.

verses.en: Jesus answered and said unto her, If thou knewest the gift of God, and who it is that saith to thee, Give me to drink; thou wouldest have asked of him, and he would have given thee living water.
verses.sm: Ua tali atu Iesu, ua faapea atu ia te ia, Ana e iloa le mea foai fua a le Atua, ma le ua fai atu ia te oe, Au mai ia te au, ou te inu; po ua e ole mai ia te ia, ona foai atu lea e ia ia te oe o le vaiola.

verses.en: The woman saith unto him, Sir, thou hast nothing to draw with, and the well is deep: from whence then hast thou that living water?
verses.sm: Ua fai mai le fafine ia te ia, Le Alii e, e leai sau mea e utu ae ai, e maulalo foi le vaieli; e te maua ea ifea lena vaiola?

verses.en: Art thou greater than our father Jacob, which gave us the well, and drank thereof himself, and his children, and his cattle?
verses.sm: E sili ea oe i lo matou tamā o lakopo, na na tuu mai ia te i matou le vaieli, ua inu ai foi o ia, ma lana fanau, ma ana manu?

verses.en: Jesus answered and said unto her, Whosoever drinketh of this water shall thirst again:
verses.sm: Ua tali atu Iesu, ua faapea atu ia te ia, O le inu i lenei vai e toe fia inu ia.

verses.en: But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.
verses.sm: A o se inu i le vai ou te avatu ia te ia, e le toe fia inu ia e faavavau ; a o le vai ou te avatu ia te ia, e avea i totonu ia te ia o le vaipuna, e puna i luga i le ola e faavavau.

verses.en: The woman saith unto him, Sir, give me this water, that I thirst not, neither come hither to draw.
verses.sm: Ua fai mai le fafine ia te ia, Le Alii e, au mai ia te au lena vai, ina ia ou le toe fia inu, ina ia ou le toe sau foi iinei e ulu vai.

verses.en: Jesus saith unto her, Go, call thy husband, and come hither.
verses.sm: Ua fetalai atu Iesu ia te ia, Alu ia oe, valaau i lau tane, i le toe sau iinei.

verses.en: The woman answered and said, I have no husband. Jesus said unto her, Thou hast well said, I have no husband:
verses.sm: Ua tali mai le fafine, ua faapea mai, E leai sa‘u tane. Ona fetalai atu lea o Iesu ia te ia, Ua tonu lau upu, E leai sau tane;

verses.en: For thou hast had five husbands; and he whom thou now hast is not thy husband: in that saidst thou truly.
verses.sm: auā sa ia te oe tane e toalima; o ia foi ua ia te oe i ona po nei, e le sau tane lea; o le mea moni lava ua e fai mai na.

verses.en: The woman saith unto him, Sir, I perceive that thou art a prophet.
verses.sm: Ua fai mai le fafine ia te ia, Le Alii e, ua ou iloa nei o oe o le perofeta.

verses.en: Our fathers worshipped in this mountain; and ye say, that in Jerusalem is the place where men ought to worship.
verses.sm: O matou tamā sa tapuai i lenei maiiiga; a ua outou fai mai, o Ierusalema le mea e tusa ai ona tapuai ai.

verses.en: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, believe me, the hour cometh, when ye shall neither in this mountain, nor yet at Jerusalem, worship the Father.
verses.sm: Ua fetalai atu Iesu ia te ia, Funa e, talitonu mai ia ia te au, e oo mai ona aso, tou te tapuai i le Tamā e le gata i lenei mauga, po o Ierusalema.

verses.en: Ye worship ye know not what: we know what we worship: for salvation is of the Jews.
verses.sm: Tou te tapuai ma le le iloa ; a ua matou tapuai ma le iloa; auā mai ia Iutaia le faaolataga.

verses.en: But the hour cometh, and now is, when the true worshippers shall worship the Father in spirit and in truth: for the Father seeketh such to worship him.
verses.sm: A e oo mai ona aso, ua oo nei foi i ai, o e tapuai faamaoni latou te tapuai i le Tamā i le agaga ma le faamaoni; auā o loo saili le Tamā i e tapuai faapena ia te ia.

verses.en: God is a Spirit: and they that worship him must worship him in spirit and in truth.
verses.sm: O le Atua o le agaga lava ia ; o e tapuai ia te ia, e tatau ona tapuai atu ai i le agaga ma le faamaoni.

verses.en: The woman saith unto him, I know that Messias cometh, which is called Christ: when he is come, he will tell us all things.
verses.sm: Ua fai mai le fafine ia te ia, Ua ou iloa o le a maliu mai le Mesia, (o le ua igoa ia Keriso,) pe a maliu mai o ia, e faailoa mai mea uma ia te i matou.

verses.en: Jesus saith unto her, I that speak unto thee am he.
verses.sm: Ona fetalai atu lea o Iesu ia te ia, O a4u lava lenei, o le tautala atu ia te oe.

verses.en: And upon this came his disciples, and marvelled that he talked with the woman: yet no man said, What seekest thou? or, Why talkest thou with her?
verses.sm: Ona o mai lea o ona soo, ua ofo ina ua tautala i laua ma le fafine ; a e lei faapea mai se tasi, Pe se a se mea e te saili na? pe faapea, O le a le mea ua oulua tautala ai ma ia?

verses.en: The woman then left her waterpot, and went her way into the city, and saith to the men,
verses.sm: Ona tuu lea e le fafine o lana vai, a e alu atu i le aai, ua fai atu i tagata,

verses.en: Come, see a man, which told me all things that ever I did: is not this the Christ?
verses.sm: Ina o mai ia; ina vaai i le tagata ua na ta‘ua mai ia te au o mea uma lava ua ou faia ; pe le o le Keriso ea lea?

verses.en: Then they went out of the city, and came unto him.
verses.sm: Ona latou o ai lea i tua o le aai, ua o mai ia te ia.

verses.en: In the mean while his disciples prayed him, saying, Master, eat.
verses.sm: A o fai lea mea, ua aioi mai ona soo ia te ia, ua faapea mai, Rapi e, ina taumafa ia.

verses.en: But he said unto them, I have meat to eat that ye know not of.
verses.sm: A ua fetalai atu o ia ia te i latou, O ia te au mea e ‘ai tou te le iloa.

verses.en: Therefore said the disciples one to another, Hath any man brought him ought to eat?
verses.sm: Ona fetautalatala‘i lea o le au soo, Pe na au mai e se tasi sana mea e ‘ai.

verses.en: Jesus saith unto them, My meat is to do the will of him that sent me, and to finish his work.
verses.sm: Ua fetalai atu Iesu ia te i latou, O la‘u mea e ‘ai,ia ou faia le finagalo o le na auina mai a‘u, ma faaiu lana galuega.

verses.en: Say not ye, There are yet four months, and then cometh harvest? behold, I say unto you, Lift up your eyes, and look on the fields; for they are white already to harvest.
verses.sm: Tou te le fai ane ea, E toe fa masina, i le oo ai i le seleselegāsaito ; faauta, ou te fai atu ia te outou, ina tepa ae ia o outou mata, ma vaavaai i le fanua ua sinasina mai nei i le seleselegāsaito.

verses.en: And he that reapeth receiveth wages, and gathereth fruit unto life eternal: that both he that soweth and he that reapeth may rejoice together.
verses.sm: O le selesele foi, e maua lana totogi, ma faaputu le fua e oo i le ola faavavau ; ina ia faatau olioli o le lulu saito ma le selesele.

verses.en: And herein is that saying true, One soweth, and another reapeth.
verses.sm: O lenei mea foi ua faamaoni ai le upu, Ese le lulu saito ese le selesele.

verses.en: I sent you to reap that whereon ye bestowed no labour: other men laboured, and ye are entered into their labours.
verses.sm: Ua ou auina atu outou e selesele i le mea sa outou le galulue ai; na galulue isi tagata, a ua oo atu outou i la latou galuega.

verses.en: And many of the Samaritans of that city believed on him for the saying of the woman, which testified, He told me all that ever I did.
verses.sm: E toatele Samaria i lea aai na faatuatua ia te ia, ona o le upu a le fafine na ia fai atu, U,a na ta‘ua mai ia te au o mea uma lava ua ou faia.

verses.en: So when the Samaritans were come unto him, they besought him that he would tarry with them: and he abode there two days.
verses.sm: Ua o mai foi tagata o Samaria ia te ia, ona latou aioi mai lea ia te ia, latou te nonofo ma i latou; ona nofo ai lea o ia i lea mea i aso e lua.

verses.en: And many more believed because of his own word;
verses.sm: Ua atili ai ona toatele o e na faatuatua ia te ia ona o lana fetalaiga ;

verses.en: And said unto the woman, Now we believe, not because of thy saying: for we have heard him ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Saviour of the world.
verses.sm: ua fai atu foi i latou i le fafine, E le ona o lau upu ua matou faatuatua ai nei ia te ia; auā o i matou lava ua matou faalogologo, ua matou iloa foi, e moni lava, o le Faaola lenei o le lalolagi, o le Keriso lava.

verses.en: Now after two days he departed thence, and went into Galilee.
verses.sm: Ua mavae ia aso e lua, ona tuua ai lea e ia o lea mea, a e rnaliu atu i Kalilaia;

verses.en: For Jesus himself testified, that a prophet hath no honour in his own country.
verses.sm: auā ua fetalai lava Iesu, E le mamalu se perofeta i lona lava nuu.

verses.en: Then when he was come into Galilee, the Galilaeans received him, having seen all the things that he did at Jerusalem at the feast: for they also went unto the feast.
verses.sm: Ua oo foi o ia i Kalilaia, ona talia mai lea o ia e tagata o Kalilaia, auā na latou vaai atu i mea uma lava na ia faia i Ierusalema i le tausamiga; auā o i latou foi, na o atu i latou i le tausamiga.

verses.en: So Jesus came again into Cana of Galilee, where he made the water wine. And there was a certain nobleman, whose son was sick at Capernaum.
verses.sm: Ona toe maliu atu ai lea o Iesu i Kana i Kalilaia, na ia liua ai le suāvai ma uaina. O le tasi alii foi ua ma‘i lona atalii i Kapanaumi;

verses.en: When he heard that Jesus was come out of Judaea into Galilee, he went unto him, and besought him that he would come down, and heal his son: for he was at the point of death.
verses.sm: ua faalogo o ia ua maliu mai Iesu mai Iutaia i Kalilaia, ona sau ai lea o ia ia te ia, ma faatoga mai ia te ia, ia maliu ifo e faamalolo i lona atalii, auā ua tāli oti.

verses.en: Then said Jesus unto him, Except ye see signs and wonders, ye will not believe.
verses.sm: Ona fetalai atu lea o Iesu ia te ia, Afai tou te le vaavaai i faailoga ma vavega, tou te le talitonu lava.

verses.en: The nobleman saith unto him, Sir, come down ere my child die.
verses.sm: Ua fai mai le alii ia te ia, Le Alii e, se‘i e maliu ifo, manū o lei oti si ou atalii.

verses.en: Jesus saith unto him, Go thy way; thy son liveth. And the man believed the word that Jesus had spoken unto him, and he went his way.
verses.sm: Ona fetalai atu lea o Iesu ia te ia, Alu le tagata i le upu na fetalai atu ai Iesu ia te ia, ona alu ai lea o ia.

verses.en: And as he was now going down, his servants met him, and told him, saying, Thy son liveth.
verses.sm: O alu ifo o ia ua fetaiai ma ana auauna, ona latou ta4u atu lea ia te ia, ua faapea atu, Ua ola lou atalii.

verses.en: Then enquired he of them the hour when he began to amend. And they said unto him, Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him.
verses.sm: Ona fesili atu lea o ia ia te i latou, po o le fea itu aso na afua ai ona faafeoloolo. Ua fai mai i latou ia te ia, Na mavae lava ananafi lona ma‘i vevela i le itu aso e fitu.

verses.en: So the father knew that it was at the same hour, in the which Jesus said unto him, Thy son liveth: and himself believed, and his whole house.
verses.sm: Ona iloa lea e le tamā, o le itu aso lava lea na fetalai atu ai Iesu ia te ia, Ua ola lou atalii. Ona talitonu lea o ia, atoa ma lona aiga uma.

verses.en: This is again the second miracle that Jesus did, when he was come out of Judaea into Galilee.
verses.sm: O le lua lea o faailoga na faia e Iesu, ina ua maliu mai o ia nai Iutaia i Kalilaia. O le vavega na faia e Iesu i Petesa.
